name: orbit
description: Track your logtime, know exactly when to leave, and instantly spot a free seat with our redesigned interactive cluster map.

scripts.build: echo 'No build process needed for manifest v3'
scripts.dev: echo 'Load extension in Chrome developer mode'
scripts.xpi: jar cf Orbit.xpi manifest.json clusterPage.js clusterPage.css mainPage.js assets/
scripts.bump: read -p 'Version (major, minor, patch): ' v && npm version $v -m 'release: v%s' && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && jq ".version = \"$VERSION\"" manifest.json > temp.json && mv temp.json manifest.json && git add manifest.json && git commit --amend --no-edit && read -p 'Confirmer le push ? (y/n): ' confirm && [[ $confirm == "y" ]] && git push --follow-tags

author: Guilheim C, Clement R
